approval.context: Approval of the four-card 250 x 200 mm / eight-position 270 x 270 mm active-backplane proposal.

orientation: Removable vertical cards mating into a horizontal active backplane; positive role-specific mechanical keying required.
socket_access: Remove a card with power off to reach socketed ICs. Extraction clearance and component height require actual socket/connector/guide dimensions.
power_entry: Single external regulated 5 V input at an accessible backplane edge, through a polarised through-hole connector; protection, rating and wire gauge follow the power budget.
cost_constraint: No owner price ceiling supplied. Obtain vendor quotes before fabrication.
legacy_reuse: No legacy PCB reuse accepted without pad-net and mechanical equivalence checks.

connector_provision.status: engineering candidate; exact fit and coding pending
